invariants.rationale: Loop increments index from zero upward, never below 0.
index can at most reach linesBreak.size, since loop bounds are index < linesBreak.size.
If cursor is less than or equal to the smallest possible line break, index never increments.
At exit, either index reached the end, or cursor is not greater than the current line break.
Index only increments when cursor is greater than the previous line break.
